label: Grok Imagine (xAI)
notes: Fetched 2026-10-13. Dollar rates are the us-east-1 public model catalog embedded in the xAI docs (imageGenerationModels and videoGenerationModels on the grok-imagine-video-1.5 model page) and the Imagine table at https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing. The same video and image rates are listed for us-west-2.

Video output rates are unchanged from the 2026-08-31 card: grok-imagine-video-1.5 is $0.08 / $0.14 / $0.25 per second at 480p / 720p / 1080p; grok-imagine-video is $0.05 / $0.07 at 480p / 720p. Image input is $0.01 on 1.5 and on grok-imagine-image-2.0, and $0.002 on grok-imagine-video. Input video is $0.01 per second on grok-imagine-video only; 1.5 publishes no video-input rate because editing and extension run on grok-imagine-video.

grok-imagine-image-2.0 bills by resolution and quality. The image API quality parameter defaults to auto, which the generation docs (read 2026-10-13) say currently serves generation at low and editing at medium. Diony pins those qualities on the request. 1K / 2K low are $0.04 / $0.06; 1K / 2K medium are $0.06 / $0.08. 1.5K (not requested by Diony) is $0.05 low and $0.07 medium. The headline $0.04 on the pricing page is the 1K low rate, not a flat still price.
grok-imagine-video-1.5-lite ($0.02 / $0.03 / $0.14 per second at 480p / 720p / 1080p) is on the same page and is not a Diony camera.
